title: Witches & Riches: Small Group Full-Day Tour of Salem from Boston
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

Note that per Massachusetts state law: "All children riding in passenger motor vehicles must be in a federally approved child passenger restraint that is properly fastened and secured according to the manufacturer's instructions until they are 8 years old OR over 57 inches tall." We do not provide child seats, please bring age appropriate car seats for kids who do not meet these criteria. We will not be able to allow you on the tour if you do not have child seats for everyone that needs one. A refund will not be issued the day of the tour due to lack of proper car seats. All children, regardless of age, must be registered as separate tour guests.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Exclusively available during the Halloween season!
Discover the spooky, historic city of Salem on this full-day tour from Boston, where the infamous witch trials of 1692 left a profound legacy. Begin with a pickup at your hotel before exploring Salem's haunting landmarks including the Witch Trials Memorial and the Witch House, the residence of a judge from the trials. Experience the prosperity of Salem during the Old China Trade, and enjoy 1.5 hours of free time for lunch and shopping at local eateries and unique shops. Your journey back to Boston is just as comfortable, making it convenient and enriching for history enthusiasts and curious travelers alike.

- Full-day semiprivate tour with pickup from Boston
- Visit key sites like the Witch Trials Memorial and the Witch House
- 1.5 hours of free time for lunch and shopping in Salem
- Comfortable transportation in a van with a small group size of 1 to 9
